title: PHANTOM Vehicle CAN to SOME/IP SOA Architecture
full_script: PHANTOM GRID presents the next-generation automotive embedded networking stack. Featuring SAE J1850 CRC-8 data integrity, monotonic alive counter, and ISO 26262 ladder recovery. Signal-to-Service engine converts CAN 0x280 and 0x380 into AUTOSAR SOME/IP Event 0x8001 and 0x8002. Real-time in-memory digital twin synchronization with zero commercial token cost.
